# Load the required libraries
libgslcblas_path = "/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so"

ctypes.CDLL(libgslcblas_path, mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL(libgsl_path)

# Define the result structure used by GSL
class GSLResult(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("val", ctypes.c_double),
        ("err", ctypes.c_double)
    ]

# Define the function prototype for gsl_sf_hyperg_0F1
# int gsl_sf_hyperg_0F1_e(const double c, const double x, gsl_sf_result * result);
gsl.gsl_sf_hyperg_0F1_e.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(GSLResult)]

def hyperg_0F1(c, x):
    """Compute the hypergeometric function 0F1 using GSL."""
    result = GSLResult()
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_hyperg_0F1_e(ctypes.c_double(c), ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.byref(result))
    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Error calling gsl_sf_hyperg_0F1_e: status {status}")
    return result.val
